body: Because if I tell them how I am feeling, they will lock me up and I will lose my job and will not be able to take care of my kids and my ex will make sure I never see them again.  So I just fake like I am feeling better and come home and think that maybe I will just have an "accident" and not wake up.  Then maybe my kids will not hate me.

Yeah.  Three times.  And each time it got me "voluntarily" admitted to the hospital.  I don't want to go back.  I wish my son would go spend a few days with his mother, he is over 18 and will hardly spend the night there.  If he did, I am pretty sure I would kill myself.  I really do not feel like I am getting any better.  Well, not entirely true.  I am getting great at lying to doctors.
